component.name: President Grand Prix
component.summary: Politico-satirical top-down party racer for 1 to 4 players

description.p: No left or right anymore, just a finish line; may the fastest win. Inspired by Super Skidmarks on the Amiga, President Grand Prix is a fast-paced, chaotic top-down arcade party racer built with Godot.

ul.li: 1 to 4 player local multiplayer with gamepads, or 2 players sharing one keyboard
Fast arcade drift physics across custom city and circuit tracks
100% Free and Open Source (GPLv3 code and CC-BY 4.0 assets)

screenshot.caption: Four cars drifting around tight corners in President Grand Prix

description.p: Added safer ramp boundaries, clearer UI focus feedback, and global fullscreen and quit shortcuts.
